Highlights

  • Hermes Agent issue #62336 reports terminal environment snapshots capture all environment variables including credentials from Bitwarden Secrets Manager to persistent plaintext files, exposing secrets to any process with filesystem read access
  • Claude Code v2.1.325 fixes a security issue in zstd-compressed response decoding along with subagent model handling bugs in worktrees and session resumption losses after unclean exits
  • OpenAI Codex rust-v0.169.0 adds multiple side-chat tabs, search across older tasks, custom model provider management from the terminal, and Cloud connection support for images and conversation archiving on macOS and Linux

Coding Agents & Assistants

Claude Code

  • Release: v2.1.325 fixes a security issue in zstd-compressed response decoding, resolves subagent model handling bugs in worktrees and bare repos, fixes session resumption losing recent turns after unclean exits, and corrects shell commands running in deleted working directories.
  • Hot issue: #109508: users report a 403 "Attention Required" Cloudflare error when running /login on macOS, preventing authentication and loading user info; gained significant attention in the last 24 hours. (7 comments, 7 👍; +14 in the last 24h)
  • Hot issue: #108679: users report new Claude Code sessions on macOS get "Browser extension is not connected" for Chrome integration since 2026-11-07, while existing sessions continue working; retrying and restarts do not resolve it. (regression; 5 comments, 3 👍; +3 since 2026-11-12)
  • News: Elevated errors on claude.ai, Claude Code, and platform.claude.com — status page confirms elevated errors across Claude services.
  • News: Anthropic upgrades Claude Code Projects to run parallel AI workers — new beta experience enables parallel AI workers in Claude Code Projects.
  • News: Claude Code and Codex reverse engineered my 1994 Jeep's ECU over a $3 Arduino — title only.

OpenAI Codex

  • Release: rust-v0.169.0 adds multiple side-chat tabs in the terminal workspace, search across older tasks, collapsible turn details in transcripts, custom model provider management from the terminal, Ctrl+S to save diagnostic ZIPs locally, and Cloud connection support for images, model selection, and conversation archiving on macOS/Linux; fixes codex exec trust handling, plan handoff on "Yes, clear context and implement", Windows sandbox path handling, and pasted image orientation on macOS.
  • Hot issue: #61348: users request a continuous engineering workspace across ChatGPT, Work, and Codex with durable, verifiable project experience instead of disposable tasks; framed as a cross-product UX/product-design request. (14 comments, 0 👍; +13 in the last 24h)
  • News: Claude Code and Codex reverse engineered my 1994 Jeep's ECU over a $3 Arduino — title only.

OpenCode

  • Release: v2.3.0 makes background subagents the default (return immediately, run concurrently, report when idle), quiets transcripts by summarizing tool calls into collapsible activity rows, adds jump-to-prompt navigation (Cmd+Alt+G), adds experimental MCP events and shell timeout background flags, moves local Windows shell commands to the process daemon, and adds LM Studio decision-model support.

DeepSeek Harness

  • Prerelease: dsh-v0.2.2-rc.3 adds an experimental DeepSeek chat import plugin to bring past conversations from the DeepSeek App or web into the workspace, and fixes Windows desktop in-app updates that could fail and prevent automatic reopening.

Hermes Agent

  • Hot issue: #62336: an issue says terminal environment snapshots in tools/environments/base.py capture all environment variables — including credential-bearing vars from bws run -- and Bitwarden Secrets Manager — to persistent plaintext files at cache/terminal/hermes-snap-*.sh, exposing secrets to any process with filesystem read access. (type/security; 19 comments, 0 👍; +3 in the last 24h)

AI Policy 2026-11-07

⬛ Overview · 🟪 AI Agents · 🟦 AI Models & Labs · 🟧 AI Policy · 🟨 Data Engineering

Sources: European Commission + Tweede Kamer + Rijksoverheid + Politico Europe + Binnenlands Bestuur | 8 new items ranked by Jev relevance | Generated: 2026-11-07 05:47 UTC

Highlights

The Dutch Cabinet published its AI vision (Kabinetsvisie op Artificial Intelligence – kiezen voor AI voor iedereen) alongside formal responses to the SER advice on work and AI and to the AI Deltaplan and Europe2031 report, signalling a national push for “open strategic autonomy” while acknowledging persistent US and Chinese influence. The European Commission preliminarily found TikTok’s recommender system in breach of the Digital Services Act for creating harmful “rabbit holes,” marking the first time the Commission has targeted a platform’s algorithmic recommendations as a DSA violation. The Dutch College voor de Rechten van de Mens warns it receives only half the funding needed for fundamental-rights oversight of AI systems, raising questions about supervisory capacity. Two EU consultations close soon: the Articles 75c–75d AI Act Implementing Act (9 November) and the Cloud and AI Development Act (11 November).
